result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices at the intersection. The existing sidewalk is narrow, in poor condition, and obstructed by objects, forcing pedestrians into a wide, unmarked roadway with no protection from vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The lack of marked crosswalks and traffic control signs at the intersection creates confusion regarding right-of-way and fails to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A shopping cart and fire hydrant on a narrow, degraded sidewalk segment restrict the usable path for pedestrians, particularly those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk corner

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corner creates a physical barrier for wheelchair users and people with strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance, improve sight lines, and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices. Visibility is significantly impaired by a large parked truck and a mature tree at the corners, creating a high-risk environment for crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted markings exist to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing activity.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck and a mature tree block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: The intersection appears to have no stop signs or signals to regulate vehicle right-of-way.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility and define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing corner parking.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant ramps with tactile warnings to provide an accessible path of travel.

result.summary: The environment is a typical urban side street with a lack of formal pedestrian infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, traffic signals, or stop signs visible, and parked vehicles near the corner may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at an intersection increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts as there is no designated crossing point.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner can hide pedestrians from approaching drivers, reducing reaction time.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where the grey car is parked near the building corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.
